items.question: Trong câu "A business process automation project replaces manual work with software, or connects disconnected steps into a seamless flow.", từ "seamless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business process automation project replaces manual work with software, or connects disconnected steps into a seamless flow.", what does "seamless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: seamless /ˈsiːmləs/ (tính từ): liền mạch, trơn tru. "Seamless flow/experience" = luồng/trải nghiệm liền mạch, không bị gián đoạn.
items.explanationEn: seamless /ˈsiːmləs/ (adjective): smooth, without breaks. A "seamless flow" or "seamless experience" runs smoothly with no interruptions.

items.question: Trong câu "Approval steps exist because there was no other way to enforce control.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Approval steps exist because there was no other way to enforce control.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
options: thực thi, bắt buộc tuân theo
optionsEn: to make sure a rule is obeyed
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): thực thi, bắt buộc tuân theo. "Enforce a rule/control" = đảm bảo quy tắc được tuân thủ; phần mềm có thể tự động "enforce".
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make sure a rule is obeyed. "Enforce a rule" means making sure it is followed; software can enforce rules automatically.

items.question: Trong câu "Integration makes the whole step vanish.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integration makes the whole step vanish.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Vanish" = biến mất hoàn toàn; tích hợp hệ thống khiến bước nhập liệu lại không còn cần.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear completely. "Vanish" means to disappear; integration removes the need for re-entry entirely.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequential ordering exists because paper can only be in one place at a time.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequential ordering exists because paper can only be in one place at a time.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwenʃl/ (tính từ): tuần tự, lần lượt. "Sequential" = theo thứ tự lần lượt; trái với "parallel" (song song).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwenʃl/ (adjective): one after another. "Sequential" means one step after another, as opposed to "parallel".

items.question: Trong câu "The process is already sound; you need results fast; low organizational risk", từ "sound" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The process is already sound; you need results fast; low organizational risk", what does "sound" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sound /saʊnd/ (tính từ): vững chắc, hợp lý. "A sound process/decision" = quy trình/quyết định vững chắc, đáng tin; "sound" còn là âm thanh.
items.explanationEn: sound /saʊnd/ (adjective): solid and reliable. A "sound process" or "sound decision" is reliable; as a noun "sound" means noise.

items.question: Trong câu "There are clearly wasteful steps; the most pragmatic choice in most cases", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are clearly wasteful steps; the most pragmatic choice in most cases", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (tính từ): thực tế, thực dụng. "Pragmatic choice/approach" = lựa chọn thực tế, dựa trên điều khả thi thay vì lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (adjective): practical and realistic. A "pragmatic approach" focuses on what works in practice rather than on theory.

items.question: Trong câu "This choice must be made CONSCIOUSLY at the start of the project, because it determines scope, who must participate, and how much organizational change you have to manage.", từ "consciously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This choice must be made CONSCIOUSLY at the start of the project, because it determines scope, who must participate, and how much organizational change you have to manage.", what does "consciously" (adverb) mean?
options: có chủ ý, có ý thức
items.explanation: consciously /ˈkɒnʃəsli/ (trạng từ): có chủ ý, có ý thức. "Consciously decide" = quyết định một cách có ý thức, không để trôi theo mặc định.
items.explanationEn: consciously /ˈkɒnʃəsli/ (adverb): deliberately, with awareness. To decide consciously is to choose with full awareness rather than by default.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence for BA work: the resistance you encounter during elicitation is often NOT about the software.", từ "encounter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence for BA work: the resistance you encounter during elicitation is often NOT about the software.", what does "encounter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: encounter /ɪnˈkaʊntə(r)/ (động từ): gặp phải. "Encounter resistance/problems" = gặp phải sự phản đối/vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: encounter /ɪnˈkaʊntə(r)/ (verb): to come up against. "Encounter resistance" or "encounter problems" means to meet them along the way.

items.question: Trong câu "When a manager keeps adding requirements for reports and approvals, they may be trying to retain control the new process takes away.", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a manager keeps adding requirements for reports and approvals, they may be trying to retain control the new process takes away.", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ lại. "Retain control/staff/data" = giữ lại quyền kiểm soát/nhân sự/dữ liệu; danh từ "retention".
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. "Retain control", "retain staff" or "retain data" means to keep it; the noun is "retention".

items.question: Trong câu "Recognise this and address it directly but respectfully.", từ "address" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognise this and address it directly but respectfully.", what does "address" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (động từ): giải quyết, xử lý. "Address a problem/concern" = giải quyết vấn đề/mối lo; "address" còn có nghĩa phát biểu.
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (verb): to deal with a problem. "Address a problem" means to deal with it; it can also mean to give a speech to people.

items.question: Trong câu "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed as-is model of a process about to be replaced.", từ "exhaustively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed as-is model of a process about to be replaced.", what does "exhaustively" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách cặn kẽ, đầy đủ
items.explanation: exhaustively /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪvli/ (trạng từ): một cách cặn kẽ, đầy đủ. "Exhaustively detailed" = chi tiết cặn kẽ đến mức bao phủ mọi thứ; khác với "exhausted" (kiệt sức).
items.explanationEn: exhaustively /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪvli/ (adverb): completely, covering everything. "Exhaustively detailed" means covering every detail; not to be confused with "exhausted" (very tired).

items.question: Trong câu "A sign you have done enough: you can point at specific pain points and quantify them — how much time, how many errors, how much cost.", từ "quantify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sign you have done enough: you can point at specific pain points and quantify them — how much time, how many errors, how much cost.", what does "quantify" (verb) mean?
options: định lượng, đo bằng con số
items.explanation: quantify /ˈkwɒntɪfaɪ/ (động từ): định lượng, đo bằng con số. "Quantify" = đưa ra con số cụ thể (thời gian, lỗi, chi phí).
items.explanationEn: quantify /ˈkwɒntɪfaɪ/ (verb): to express as a number. To quantify is to put a number on something, such as time, errors or cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Total elapsed time from start to finish, including waiting", từ "elapsed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total elapsed time from start to finish, including waiting", what does "elapsed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: elapsed /ɪˈlæpst/ (tính từ): đã trôi qua. "Elapsed time" = tổng thời gian trôi qua, tính cả thời gian chờ.
items.explanationEn: elapsed /ɪˈlæpst/ (adjective): that has passed. "Elapsed time" is the total time that has passed, including waiting.

items.question: Trong câu "The time actually spent working — usually a small fraction of cycle time", từ "fraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The time actually spent working — usually a small fraction of cycle time", what does "fraction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fraction /ˈfrækʃn/ (danh từ): một phần nhỏ. "A small fraction of X" = một phần nhỏ của X; trong toán học "fraction" là phân số.
items.explanationEn: fraction /ˈfrækʃn/ (noun): a small part. "A small fraction of X" is a small part of it; in maths a fraction is a number like 1/2.

items.question: Trong câu "Push decisions to the lowest possible level — escalate only above a threshold.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Push decisions to the lowest possible level — escalate only above a threshold.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Above/below a threshold" = trên/dưới ngưỡng; nghĩa đen là ngưỡng cửa.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (noun): a level that triggers action. "Above a threshold" means past the limit that triggers action; literally, a doorway's floor.

items.question: Trong câu "That last principle deserves emphasis: a great many processes are slow for everyone because they were designed to handle rare exceptions.", từ "emphasis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That last principle deserves emphasis: a great many processes are slow for everyone because they were designed to handle rare exceptions.", what does "emphasis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: emphasis /ˈemfəsɪs/ (danh từ): sự nhấn mạnh. "Deserve/place emphasis on" = đáng được/đặt sự nhấn mạnh vào; động từ "emphasise".
items.explanationEn: emphasis /ˈemfəsɪs/ (noun): special importance or attention. "Deserves emphasis" means it should be stressed; the verb is "emphasise".

items.question: Trong câu "Experienced staff know when to accept an exception, when to escalate, when to apply a discount.", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Experienced staff know when to accept an exception, when to escalate, when to apply a discount.", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
options: chuyển lên cấp cao hơn xử lý
optionsEn: to pass to a higher authority
items.explanation: escalate /ˈeskəleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển lên cấp cao hơn xử lý. "Escalate" trong công việc = chuyển vấn đề lên cấp trên; nghĩa khác là leo thang căng thẳng.
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈeskəleɪt/ (verb): to pass to a higher authority. At work, "escalate" means passing an issue upward; it can also mean a conflict getting worse.

items.question: Trong câu "The rules contradict each other.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rules contradict each other.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn, trái ngược. "A contradicts B" = A mâu thuẫn với B; tính từ "contradictory".
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to conflict with. "A contradicts B" means they cannot both be true; the adjective is "contradictory".

items.question: Trong câu "Exceptions are handled by human judgment.", từ "judgment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exceptions are handled by human judgment.", what does "judgment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: judgment /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/ (danh từ): sự phán đoán, cân nhắc. "Human judgment" = óc phán đoán của con người; "judgment" còn là phán quyết của tòa.
items.explanationEn: judgment /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/ (noun): the ability to decide sensibly. "Human judgment" is a person's ability to decide well; it can also mean a court's ruling.

items.question: Trong câu "The design consequence: keep business rules where they can be changed without reprogramming — configuration tables, a rule engine, or at minimum a single centralised module.", từ "at minimum" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The design consequence: keep business rules where they can be changed without reprogramming — configuration tables, a rule engine, or at minimum a single centralised module.", what does "at minimum" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at minimum /ət ˈmɪnɪməm/ (cụm từ): ít nhất là. "At (a) minimum" = ít nhất cũng phải; trái nghĩa "at most".
items.explanationEn: at minimum /ət ˈmɪnɪməm/ (phrase): at the very least. "At (a) minimum" means at the very least; the opposite is "at most".

items.question: Trong câu "Who has the authority to change it?", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who has the authority to change it?", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Have the authority to do something" = có quyền làm gì; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Have the authority to do something" means the right to do it; "the authorities" means officials.

items.question: Trong câu "A rule that changes monthly must be configurable; a rule unchanged in 20 years can be hard-coded.", từ "hard-coded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A rule that changes monthly must be configurable; a rule unchanged in 20 years can be hard-coded.", what does "hard-coded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hard-coded /ˌhɑːd ˈkəʊdɪd/ (tính từ): viết cứng trong mã nguồn. "Hard-coded" = giá trị viết thẳng vào code, muốn đổi phải sửa code; trái với "configurable".
items.explanationEn: hard-coded /ˌhɑːd ˈkəʊdɪd/ (adjective): fixed directly in the code. A "hard-coded" value is written into the code, so changing it needs a code change.

items.question: Trong câu "This must be the overwhelming majority, or the benefit of automation is lost.", từ "overwhelming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This must be the overwhelming majority, or the benefit of automation is lost.", what does "overwhelming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overwhelming /ˌəʊvəˈwelmɪŋ/ (tính từ): áp đảo, rất lớn. "The overwhelming majority" = đại đa số; "overwhelming" còn có nghĩa gây choáng ngợp.
items.explanationEn: overwhelming /ˌəʊvəˈwelmɪŋ/ (adjective): very large in amount. "The overwhelming majority" means almost all; it can also describe feelings that overpower you.

items.question: Trong câu "The system must surface them clearly with enough context for the person to decide quickly.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system must surface them clearly with enough context for the person to decide quickly.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a hard top on a road
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): đưa ra, làm hiện ra. Động từ "surface" = làm cho điều gì hiện ra để người khác thấy; "issues surface" = vấn đề lộ ra.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to bring to attention. As a verb, "surface" means to bring something into view; "issues surface" when they appear.

items.question: Trong câu "Can a human override the system decision?", từ "override" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can a human override the system decision?", what does "override" (verb) mean?
options: gạt bỏ, ghi đè quyết định
optionsEn: to cancel a decision with your own
items.explanation: override /ˌəʊvəˈraɪd/ (động từ): gạt bỏ, ghi đè quyết định. "Override a decision" = dùng quyền để thay thế quyết định; trong lập trình còn là ghi đè phương thức.
items.explanationEn: override /ˌəʊvəˈraɪd/ (verb): to cancel a decision with your own. "Override a decision" means replacing it with your own; in programming it means redefining a method.

items.question: Trong câu "If so, who is permitted to, in what circumstances, and is it logged?", từ "circumstance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If so, who is permitted to, in what circumstances, and is it logged?", what does "circumstance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: circumstance /ˈsɜːkəmstəns/ (danh từ): hoàn cảnh, trường hợp. "In what circumstances" = trong những trường hợp nào; "under no circumstances" = không bao giờ.
items.explanationEn: circumstance /ˈsɜːkəmstəns/ (noun): a situation or condition. "In what circumstances" means in which situations; "under no circumstances" means never.

items.question: Trong câu "A frequently missed requirement: exception handling capability and an audit trail for every manual intervention.", từ "audit trail" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A frequently missed requirement: exception handling capability and an audit trail for every manual intervention.", what does "audit trail" (phrase) mean?
options: nhật ký kiểm tra vết thao tác
optionsEn: a record of who did what and when
items.explanation: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (cụm từ): nhật ký kiểm tra vết thao tác. "Audit trail" = bản ghi lại ai làm gì, lúc nào, để truy vết sau này.
items.explanationEn: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (phrase): a record of who did what and when. An audit trail records who did what and when, so actions can be traced later.

items.question: Trong câu "Without them, an automated process deadlocks on the first case it did not anticipate — and users go back to doing it manually outside the system.", từ "deadlock" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without them, an automated process deadlocks on the first case it did not anticipate — and users go back to doing it manually outside the system.", what does "deadlock" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get stuck and unable to continue
items.explanation: deadlock /ˈdedlɒk/ (động từ): bị kẹt, bế tắc. "Deadlock" = rơi vào bế tắc, không tiến được; trong lập trình là khóa chết giữa các tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: deadlock /ˈdedlɒk/ (verb): to get stuck and unable to continue. "Deadlock" means reaching a standstill; in programming it is processes blocking each other forever.

items.question: Trong câu "Without them, an automated process deadlocks on the first case it did not anticipate — and users go back to doing it manually outside the system.", từ "anticipate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without them, an automated process deadlocks on the first case it did not anticipate — and users go back to doing it manually outside the system.", what does "anticipate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: anticipate /ænˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (động từ): lường trước, dự đoán. "Anticipate a problem" = lường trước vấn đề; nghĩa khác là háo hức mong đợi.
items.explanationEn: anticipate /ænˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (verb): to foresee and prepare for. "Anticipate a problem" means to foresee it; it can also mean to look forward to something.

items.question: Trong câu "A business analytics project builds the capability to analyse data to support decisions — data warehouses, reports, dashboards, predictive models.", từ "predictive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business analytics project builds the capability to analyse data to support decisions — data warehouses, reports, dashboards, predictive models.", what does "predictive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: predictive /prɪˈdɪktɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính dự đoán. "Predictive model" = mô hình dự đoán điều sẽ xảy ra; động từ "predict".
items.explanationEn: predictive /prɪˈdɪktɪv/ (adjective): used to forecast the future. A "predictive model" forecasts what will happen; the verb is "predict".

items.question: Trong câu "In a transactional system you can enumerate functions.", từ "enumerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a transactional system you can enumerate functions.", what does "enumerate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enumerate /ɪˈnjuːməreɪt/ (động từ): liệt kê từng cái. "Enumerate" = liệt kê đầy đủ từng mục; hệ thống giao dịch có thể liệt kê hết chức năng.
items.explanationEn: enumerate /ɪˈnjuːməreɪt/ (verb): to list one by one. To enumerate is to list items one by one; transactional functions can be fully listed.

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot specify the full set of queries in advance.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot specify the full set of queries in advance.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước, từ trước. "In advance" = trước khi việc xảy ra; đừng nhầm với "advanced" (nâng cao).
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "In advance" means beforehand; do not confuse it with "advanced" (high-level).

items.question: Trong câu "Reconciling metric definitions is PURE business analysis work and is usually the most valuable contribution a BA makes to an analytics project.", từ "reconcile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reconciling metric definitions is PURE business analysis work and is usually the most valuable contribution a BA makes to an analytics project.", what does "reconcile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (động từ): thống nhất, làm cho khớp. "Reconcile definitions/figures" = làm các định nghĩa/số liệu khớp nhau; nghĩa khác là hòa giải.
items.explanationEn: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (verb): to make consistent. "Reconcile definitions" means making them agree; with people it means ending a quarrel.

items.question: Trong câu "Reconciling metric definitions is PURE business analysis work and is usually the most valuable contribution a BA makes to an analytics project.", từ "contribution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reconciling metric definitions is PURE business analysis work and is usually the most valuable contribution a BA makes to an analytics project.", what does "contribution" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a part played in a result
items.explanation: contribution /ˌkɒntrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (danh từ): sự đóng góp. "Make a contribution to X" = đóng góp cho X; cũng có nghĩa khoản tiền quyên góp.
items.explanationEn: contribution /ˌkɒntrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (noun): a part played in a result. "Make a contribution to X" means to help achieve it; it can also mean a donation.

items.question: Trong câu "Along which dimensions do users need to slice the data — time, region, product, channel, customer segment?", từ "slice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Along which dimensions do users need to slice the data — time, region, product, channel, customer segment?", what does "slice" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cut food into thin pieces
to break data down by a dimension
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (động từ): chia dữ liệu theo chiều. "Slice the data (by X)" = chia/xem dữ liệu theo một chiều như thời gian, khu vực.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (verb): to break data down by a dimension. "Slice the data by X" means viewing it broken down by a dimension such as time or region.

items.question: Trong câu "What hierarchy does each dimension have — day → week → month → quarter → year?", từ "hierarchy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What hierarchy does each dimension have — day → week → month → quarter → year?", what does "hierarchy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (danh từ): hệ thống cấp bậc. "Hierarchy" = cấu trúc nhiều cấp; ví dụ ngày → tuần → tháng.
items.explanationEn: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (noun): an ordering by levels. A hierarchy is a structure of levels, such as day to week to month.

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the biggest cost levers on an analytics project.", từ "lever" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the biggest cost levers on an analytics project.", what does "lever" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a bar used to lift things
items.explanation: lever /ˈliːvə(r)/ (danh từ): yếu tố tác động mạnh. "Cost lever" = yếu tố mà thay đổi nó sẽ ảnh hưởng lớn tới chi phí; nghĩa đen là đòn bẩy.
items.explanationEn: lever /ˈliːvə(r)/ (noun): a factor that strongly influences. A "cost lever" is a factor that moves cost a lot; literally, a lever is a bar for lifting.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a hard question and is usually deferred until too late.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a hard question and is usually deferred until too late.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜː(r)/ (động từ): trì hoãn. "Defer until later" = để lại sau; "defer to someone" lại có nghĩa là nghe theo ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜː(r)/ (verb): to put off until later. "Defer until later" means to postpone; "defer to someone" means to accept their view.

items.question: Trong câu "Transactional systems can run perfectly well on inconsistent data, because each transaction is processed individually.", từ "inconsistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transactional systems can run perfectly well on inconsistent data, because each transaction is processed individually.", what does "inconsistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): không nhất quán. "Inconsistent data" = dữ liệu không thống nhất giữa các bản ghi/nguồn.
items.explanationEn: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): not matching or uniform. "Inconsistent data" does not match across records or sources.

items.question: Trong câu "Only when you aggregate millions of records does the inconsistency become visible and produce wrong numbers.", từ "aggregate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only when you aggregate millions of records does the inconsistency become visible and produce wrong numbers.", what does "aggregate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: aggregate /ˈæɡrɪɡeɪt/ (động từ): tổng hợp, gộp lại. "Aggregate data" = gộp nhiều bản ghi thành số tổng (tổng, trung bình...).
items.explanationEn: aggregate /ˈæɡrɪɡeɪt/ (verb): to combine into a total. To aggregate data is to combine many records into totals or averages.

items.question: Trong câu "Meaning drift over time — a status code repurposed for something else in 2018.", từ "drift" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Meaning drift over time — a status code repurposed for something else in 2018.", what does "drift" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (danh từ): sự thay đổi dần dần. "Drift" = sự lệch dần theo thời gian; nghĩa đen là trôi dạt theo dòng nước.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (noun): a slow gradual change. "Drift" is a slow shift over time; literally, being carried along by water or wind.

items.question: Trong câu "An essential but frequently missing requirement: the system must indicate which data is NOT trustworthy.", từ "trustworthy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An essential but frequently missing requirement: the system must indicate which data is NOT trustworthy.", what does "trustworthy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstwɜːði/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. "Trustworthy data" = dữ liệu đáng tin; trái nghĩa "untrustworthy".
items.explanationEn: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstwɜːði/ (adjective): able to be relied on. "Trustworthy data" can be relied on; the opposite is "untrustworthy".

items.question: Trong câu "A report showing a number without disclosing that it rests on records 40 percent of which are incomplete is worse than no report at all — because it manufactures false confidence.", từ "disclose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A report showing a number without disclosing that it rests on records 40 percent of which are incomplete is worse than no report at all — because it manufactures false confidence.", what does "disclose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disclose /dɪsˈkləʊz/ (động từ): tiết lộ, công bố. "Disclose that..." = cho biết/công bố rằng...; danh từ "disclosure".
items.explanationEn: disclose /dɪsˈkləʊz/ (verb): to make known. "Disclose that..." means to reveal it openly; the noun is "disclosure".

items.question: Trong câu "A report showing a number without disclosing that it rests on records 40 percent of which are incomplete is worse than no report at all — because it manufactures false confidence.", từ "manufacture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A report showing a number without disclosing that it rests on records 40 percent of which are incomplete is worse than no report at all — because it manufactures false confidence.", what does "manufacture" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make goods in a factory
items.explanation: manufacture /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃə(r)/ (động từ): tạo ra (một cách giả tạo). Nghĩa bóng "manufacture confidence/consent" = tạo ra điều giả tạo; nghĩa gốc là sản xuất.
items.explanationEn: manufacture /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃə(r)/ (verb): to create something false. Figuratively, "manufacture confidence" means creating it artificially; literally, to produce goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Data owners — who is accountable for the quality and definition of each dataset?", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data owners — who is accountable for the quality and definition of each dataset?", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm. "Be accountable for X" = chịu trách nhiệm giải trình về X.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (adjective): responsible and answerable. "Be accountable for X" means you must answer for it.

items.question: Trong câu "The scope must be agreed explicitly up front: does your analytics project include ESTABLISHING data governance, or only CONSUMING data as it stands?", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The scope must be agreed explicitly up front: does your analytics project include ESTABLISHING data governance, or only CONSUMING data as it stands?", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: at the end of the project
items.explanation: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Agree up front" = thống nhất ngay từ đầu; "be up front about" = thẳng thắn về điều gì.
items.explanationEn: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the beginning. "Agree up front" means at the start; "be up front about something" means to be honest about it.

items.question: Trong câu "Many analytics projects blow their budget badly because this question was never answered, and the team discovers mid-project that it must solve data problems ten years in the making.", từ "blow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many analytics projects blow their budget badly because this question was never answered, and the team discovers mid-project that it must solve data problems ten years in the making.", what does "blow" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go far over a limit
items.explanation: blow /bləʊ/ (động từ): vượt, phá vỡ (ngân sách). "Blow the budget" = tiêu vượt ngân sách nghiêm trọng; nghĩa đen là thổi.
items.explanationEn: blow /bləʊ/ (verb): to go far over a limit. "Blow the budget" means to overspend badly; literally, "blow" means to push out air.

items.question: Trong câu "Analytics concentrates data from many sources — which creates new security risks.", từ "concentrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analytics concentrates data from many sources — which creates new security risks.", what does "concentrate" (verb) mean?
options: gom tập trung về một chỗ
chú tâm, tập trung tinh thần
optionsEn: to bring together in one place
items.explanation: concentrate /ˈkɒnsntreɪt/ (động từ): gom tập trung về một chỗ. "Concentrate data" = gom dữ liệu về một nơi; "concentrate on" = tập trung chú ý vào.
items.explanationEn: concentrate /ˈkɒnsntreɪt/ (verb): to bring together in one place. "Concentrate data" means gathering it in one place; "concentrate on" means to focus attention.

items.question: Trong câu "Embedded systems are software running inside a device — cars, medical devices, industrial machinery, appliances, network equipment.", từ "appliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Embedded systems are software running inside a device — cars, medical devices, industrial machinery, appliances, network equipment.", what does "appliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: appliance /əˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): thiết bị gia dụng. "Appliance" = đồ gia dụng như tủ lạnh, máy giặt; đừng nhầm với "application".
items.explanationEn: appliance /əˈplaɪəns/ (noun): a household machine. An appliance is a household machine such as a fridge; do not confuse it with "application".

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements must be allocated between hardware, software, and mechanics — and that decision has large cost and flexibility consequences.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements must be allocated between hardware, software, and mechanics — and that decision has large cost and flexibility consequences.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, phân chia. "Allocate X between A and B" = phân chia X cho A và B; danh từ "allocation".
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to assign or distribute. "Allocate X between A and B" means dividing it between them; the noun is "allocation".

items.question: Trong câu "The allocation principle: what may need to change after shipping should live in software; what demands extreme performance or reliability usually lives in hardware.", từ "reliability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The allocation principle: what may need to change after shipping should live in software; what demands extreme performance or reliability usually lives in hardware.", what does "reliability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reliability /rɪˌlaɪəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): độ tin cậy. "Reliability" = khả năng hoạt động ổn định, không hỏng; tính từ "reliable".
items.explanationEn: reliability /rɪˌlaɪəˈbɪləti/ (noun): the quality of working dependably. Reliability is the ability to keep working without failure; the adjective is "reliable".

items.question: Trong câu "Memory, processing power, and energy are all limited and cannot be expanded once the product ships.", từ "expand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memory, processing power, and energy are all limited and cannot be expanded once the product ships.", what does "expand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (động từ): mở rộng, tăng thêm. "Expand memory/capacity" = tăng bộ nhớ/dung lượng; danh từ "expansion".
items.explanationEn: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (verb): to make larger. "Expand memory" or "expand capacity" means to increase it; the noun is "expansion".

items.question: Trong câu "An airbag deploying at 200 milliseconds instead of 20 is useless — or dangerous.", từ "deploy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An airbag deploying at 200 milliseconds instead of 20 is useless — or dangerous.", what does "deploy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (động từ): bung ra, kích hoạt. Với túi khí, "deploy" = bung ra; với phần mềm, "deploy" = triển khai lên môi trường chạy.
items.explanationEn: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (verb): to open out and activate. For an airbag, "deploy" means to inflate; for software, it means to release to production.

items.question: Trong câu "Soft real-time: missing the deadline degrades quality but remains acceptable.", từ "degrade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Soft real-time: missing the deadline degrades quality but remains acceptable.", what does "degrade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (động từ): làm suy giảm. "Degrade quality/performance" = làm giảm chất lượng/hiệu năng; "degraded mode" = chế độ suy giảm.
items.explanationEn: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (verb): to make worse in quality. "Degrade performance" means to lower it; "degraded mode" runs with reduced function.

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot patch easily.", từ "patch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot patch easily.", what does "patch" (verb) mean?
options: vá lỗi, cập nhật bản sửa
optionsEn: to sew a piece over a hole
items.explanation: patch /pætʃ/ (động từ): vá lỗi, cập nhật bản sửa. "Patch" = phát hành bản sửa lỗi; nghĩa gốc là vá quần áo.
items.explanationEn: patch /pætʃ/ (verb): to apply a software fix. "Patch" means to release a fix for software; originally, to mend a hole in cloth.

items.question: Trong câu "The direct consequence: the cost of a requirements defect in an embedded system is ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE higher than in enterprise software.", từ "orders of magnitude" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The direct consequence: the cost of a requirements defect in an embedded system is ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE higher than in enterprise software.", what does "orders of magnitude" (phrase) mean?
options: gấp hàng chục, hàng trăm lần
optionsEn: many times, by factors of ten
items.explanation: orders of magnitude /ˈɔːdəz əv ˈmæɡnɪtjuːd/ (cụm từ): gấp hàng chục, hàng trăm lần. "Orders of magnitude" = chênh lệch theo bậc 10 (x10, x100...), tức lớn hơn rất nhiều.
items.explanationEn: orders of magnitude /ˈɔːdəz əv ˈmæɡnɪtjuːd/ (phrase): many times, by factors of ten. "Orders of magnitude" means differences by factors of ten, so vastly larger.

items.question: Trong câu "This justifies far greater investment in requirements engineering — deeper specification, stricter review, more modeling.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This justifies far greater investment in requirements engineering — deeper specification, stricter review, more modeling.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
options: biện minh, là lý do chính đáng cho
optionsEn: to give a good reason for
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (động từ): biện minh, là lý do chính đáng cho. "X justifies Y" = X là lý do chính đáng cho Y; trong soạn thảo, "justify" là căn đều hai bên.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to give a good reason for. "X justifies Y" means X makes Y reasonable; in word processing it means aligning text.

items.question: Trong câu "The physical world is not polite and does not honour your assumptions.", từ "honour" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The physical world is not polite and does not honour your assumptions.", what does "honour" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: honour /ˈɒnə(r)/ (động từ): tuân theo, tôn trọng. "Honour an agreement/assumption" = giữ đúng, tuân theo; nghĩa khác là vinh danh.
items.explanationEn: honour /ˈɒnə(r)/ (verb): to respect or keep to. "Honour an agreement" means to keep to it; it can also mean to give someone an award.

items.question: Trong câu "Embedded systems are usually state machines in the literal sense", từ "literal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Embedded systems are usually state machines in the literal sense", what does "literal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: literal /ˈlɪtərəl/ (tính từ): theo nghĩa đen. "In the literal sense" = theo đúng nghĩa đen; trái với "figurative".
items.explanationEn: literal /ˈlɪtərəl/ (adjective): in the exact basic meaning. "In the literal sense" means exactly as the words say; the opposite is "figurative".

items.question: Trong câu "Identify every signal and interface crossing the system boundary", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identify every signal and interface crossing the system boundary", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "System boundary" = ranh giới giữa hệ thống và môi trường bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): the dividing edge. The "system boundary" separates the system from its outside environment.

items.question: Trong câu "Every sensor and actuator needs specification: value range, resolution, sampling rate, units, accuracy, behaviour out of range, behaviour when the device fails.", từ "resolution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every sensor and actuator needs specification: value range, resolution, sampling rate, units, accuracy, behaviour out of range, behaviour when the device fails.", what does "resolution" (noun) mean?
options: độ phân giải, mức chi tiết nhỏ nhất
optionsEn: the smallest change that can be measured
items.explanation: resolution /ˌrezəˈluːʃn/ (danh từ): độ phân giải, mức chi tiết nhỏ nhất. Với cảm biến, "resolution" = thay đổi nhỏ nhất đo được; từ này còn nghĩa là nghị quyết, quyết tâm.
items.explanationEn: resolution /ˌrezəˈluːʃn/ (noun): the smallest change that can be measured. For a sensor, resolution is the smallest detectable change; it can also mean a motion or determination.

items.question: Trong câu "Each has its own behaviour, and all transitions between them must be fully specified.", từ "transition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each has its own behaviour, and all transitions between them must be fully specified.", what does "transition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a change from one state to another
items.explanation: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự chuyển đổi (trạng thái). "Transition between modes/states" = chuyển từ chế độ/trạng thái này sang cái khác.
items.explanationEn: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (noun): a change from one state to another. A "transition between states" is the move from one state or mode to another.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the safe state on sudden power loss?", từ "sudden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the safe state on sudden power loss?", what does "sudden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sudden /ˈsʌdn/ (tính từ): đột ngột. "Sudden power loss" = mất điện đột ngột; trạng từ "suddenly".
items.explanationEn: sudden /ˈsʌdn/ (adjective): happening unexpectedly and quickly. "Sudden power loss" happens without warning; the adverb is "suddenly".

items.question: Trong câu "What does a field technician need to diagnose a fault?", từ "diagnose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What does a field technician need to diagnose a fault?", what does "diagnose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: diagnose /ˈdaɪəɡnəʊz/ (động từ): chẩn đoán, tìm nguyên nhân. "Diagnose a fault" = tìm ra nguyên nhân hỏng hóc; danh từ "diagnosis", "diagnostics".
items.explanationEn: diagnose /ˈdaɪəɡnəʊz/ (verb): to identify the cause of. "Diagnose a fault" means finding its cause; related nouns are "diagnosis" and "diagnostics".

items.question: Trong câu "Manufacturing testability requirements are the most frequently omitted requirement type on embedded projects.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Manufacturing testability requirements are the most frequently omitted requirement type on embedded projects.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót. "Omit" = bỏ sót, không đưa vào; danh từ "omission".
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omit" means to leave something out; the noun is "omission".

items.question: Trong câu "For systems that can harm people, property, or the environment, safety is not one quality attribute among many — it is the constraint that governs everything.", từ "govern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For systems that can harm people, property, or the environment, safety is not one quality attribute among many — it is the constraint that governs everything.", what does "govern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (động từ): chi phối, quyết định. "X governs Y" = X chi phối Y; nghĩa chính trị là cai trị một đất nước.
items.explanationEn: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (verb): to control or determine. "X governs Y" means X controls it; politically, to govern is to rule a country.

items.question: Trong câu "Assess the severity and probability of each hazard.", từ "severity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assess the severity and probability of each hazard.", what does "severity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: severity /sɪˈverəti/ (danh từ): mức độ nghiêm trọng. "Severity" = độ nghiêm trọng; hay đi cặp "severity and probability" khi đánh giá rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: severity /sɪˈverəti/ (noun): how serious something is. Severity is how serious something is; risk is often rated by "severity and probability".

items.question: Trong câu "Assess the severity and probability of each hazard.", từ "hazard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assess the severity and probability of each hazard.", what does "hazard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hazard /ˈhæzəd/ (danh từ): mối nguy hiểm. "Hazard" = nguồn nguy hiểm có thể gây hại; "hazard analysis" = phân tích mối nguy.
items.explanationEn: hazard /ˈhæzəd/ (noun): a source of danger. A hazard is a potential source of harm; "hazard analysis" identifies them.

items.question: Trong câu "Determine the mitigations, and each mitigation becomes a safety requirement.", từ "mitigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Determine the mitigations, and each mitigation becomes a safety requirement.", what does "mitigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mitigation /ˌmɪtɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (danh từ): biện pháp giảm thiểu. "Mitigation" = biện pháp làm giảm rủi ro/tác hại; động từ "mitigate".
items.explanationEn: mitigation /ˌmɪtɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (noun): a measure that reduces harm. A mitigation reduces the risk or impact of harm; the verb is "mitigate".

items.question: Trong câu "You must demonstrate to a certification body that every safety requirement was implemented and verified.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must demonstrate to a certification body that every safety requirement was implemented and verified.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (động từ): chứng minh. "Demonstrate that..." = chứng minh rằng...; nghĩa khác là tham gia biểu tình.
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (verb): to prove with evidence. "Demonstrate that..." means to prove it; it can also mean to take part in a protest.

items.question: Trong câu "They frequently demand redundancy or independent mechanisms — two independent sensors, a hardware interlock.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They frequently demand redundancy or independent mechanisms — two independent sensors, a hardware interlock.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: backup parts in case one fails
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (danh từ): dự phòng (thành phần thay thế). Trong kỹ thuật, "redundancy" = có thành phần dự phòng; trong nhân sự là bị cho nghỉ việc.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (noun): backup parts in case one fails. In engineering, redundancy means backup components; in HR it means being laid off.

items.question: Trong câu "They define the fail-safe state the system enters on a fault.", từ "fail-safe" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They define the fail-safe state the system enters on a fault.", what does "fail-safe" (adjective) mean?
options: an toàn khi có sự cố
items.explanation: fail-safe /ˈfeɪl seɪf/ (tính từ): an toàn khi có sự cố. "Fail-safe state" = trạng thái an toàn mà hệ thống chuyển vào khi có lỗi.
items.explanationEn: fail-safe /ˈfeɪl seɪf/ (adjective): safe even when something fails. A "fail-safe state" is the safe condition a system enters when something goes wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Evidence must be produced throughout the project, not assembled at the end.", từ "assemble" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evidence must be produced throughout the project, not assembled at the end.", what does "assemble" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assemble /əˈsembl/ (động từ): thu gom, tập hợp lại. "Assemble evidence" = gom bằng chứng lại; "assemble a machine" = lắp ráp máy.
items.explanationEn: assemble /əˈsembl/ (verb): to gather together. "Assemble evidence" means to gather it; "assemble a machine" means to put it together.

items.question: Trong câu "Trying to reconstruct traceability documentation after the fact is extremely expensive and usually fails.", từ "after the fact" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trying to reconstruct traceability documentation after the fact is extremely expensive and usually fails.", what does "after the fact" (phrase) mean?
options: sau khi sự việc đã xong
items.explanation: after the fact /ˈɑːftə ðə fækt/ (cụm từ): sau khi sự việc đã xong. "After the fact" = khi mọi việc đã xảy ra rồi, thường là quá muộn.
items.explanationEn: after the fact /ˈɑːftə ðə fækt/ (phrase): after it has already happened. "After the fact" means once something has already happened, often too late.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardware specifications change during development, invalidating software assumptions.", từ "invalidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardware specifications change during development, invalidating software assumptions.", what does "invalidate" (verb) mean?
options: làm mất hiệu lực, làm sai
items.explanation: invalidate /ɪnˈvælɪdeɪt/ (động từ): làm mất hiệu lực, làm sai. "Invalidate an assumption" = khiến giả định không còn đúng; trái nghĩa "validate".
items.explanationEn: invalidate /ɪnˈvælɪdeɪt/ (verb): to make no longer true. "Invalidate an assumption" makes it no longer hold; the opposite is "validate".

items.question: Trong câu "The hardware-software interface must be specified extremely precisely and managed as a formal baseline.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The hardware-software interface must be specified extremely precisely and managed as a formal baseline.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): một cách chính xác. "Specify precisely" = đặc tả chính xác từng chi tiết; danh từ "precision".
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): exactly and accurately. "Specify precisely" means describing every detail exactly; the noun is "precision".

items.question: Trong câu "Hardware-software interface (HSI) requirements deserve their own document and their own change control process, because every change there affects both teams and often external suppliers too.", từ "supplier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardware-software interface (HSI) requirements deserve their own document and their own change control process, because every change there affects both teams and often external suppliers too.", what does "supplier" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: supplier /səˈplaɪə(r)/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "Supplier" = bên cung cấp linh kiện/dịch vụ; động từ "supply".
items.explanationEn: supplier /səˈplaɪə(r)/ (noun): a company that provides goods. A supplier provides parts or services; the verb is "supply".

items.question: Trong câu "This creates enormous pressure to use minimal hardware — and pushes complexity into software, where the marginal cost is zero.", từ "marginal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This creates enormous pressure to use minimal hardware — and pushes complexity into software, where the marginal cost is zero.", what does "marginal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: marginal /ˈmɑːdʒɪnl/ (tính từ): cận biên (thêm một đơn vị). "Marginal cost" = chi phí để làm thêm một đơn vị; với phần mềm gần như bằng 0.
items.explanationEn: marginal /ˈmɑːdʒɪnl/ (adjective): for one extra unit. "Marginal cost" is the cost of producing one more unit; for software it is near zero.

items.question: Trong câu "In all three contexts, the difficulty lies elsewhere:", từ "lie" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In all three contexts, the difficulty lies elsewhere:", what does "lie" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lie /laɪ/ (động từ): nằm ở, tồn tại ở. "The difficulty lies in/elsewhere" = cái khó nằm ở đâu; "lie" còn nghĩa là nói dối.
items.explanationEn: lie /laɪ/ (verb): to be found in. "The difficulty lies elsewhere" says where it is found; "lie" can also mean to tell an untruth.

items.question: Trong câu "The same defect in a shipped medical device can mean a product recall, regulatory penalties, and harm to people.", từ "recall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same defect in a shipped medical device can mean a product recall, regulatory penalties, and harm to people.", what does "recall" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recall /ˈriːkɔːl/ (danh từ): đợt thu hồi sản phẩm. "Product recall" = nhà sản xuất thu hồi sản phẩm lỗi; "recall" còn là nhớ lại.
items.explanationEn: recall /ˈriːkɔːl/ (noun): calling back faulty products. A "product recall" brings back faulty goods; "recall" can also mean to remember.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", từ "calibrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", what does "calibrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: calibrate /ˈkælɪbreɪt/ (động từ): điều chỉnh cho phù hợp. "Calibrate X to Y" = điều chỉnh mức X cho tương xứng với Y; nghĩa kỹ thuật là hiệu chuẩn thiết bị.
items.explanationEn: calibrate /ˈkælɪbreɪt/ (verb): to adjust to fit. "Calibrate X to Y" means adjusting X to match Y; technically, to calibrate an instrument.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", từ "rigour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", what does "rigour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rigour /ˈrɪɡə(r)/ (danh từ): sự chặt chẽ, kỹ lưỡng. "Rigour" (Anh-Mỹ: rigor) = sự chặt chẽ, kỹ lưỡng; tính từ "rigorous".
items.explanationEn: rigour /ˈrɪɡə(r)/ (noun): thoroughness and strictness. "Rigour" (US "rigor") means careful thoroughness; the adjective is "rigorous".

items.question: Trong câu "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", từ "overarching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the overarching principle: calibrate the rigour of your requirements work to the CONSEQUENCES OF BEING WRONG, not to personal preference or rigid organizational mandate.", what does "overarching" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overarching /ˌəʊvərˈɑːtʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): bao trùm, chung nhất. "Overarching principle/goal" = nguyên tắc/mục tiêu bao trùm lên mọi thứ khác.
items.explanationEn: overarching /ˌəʊvərˈɑːtʃɪŋ/ (adjective): covering everything. An "overarching principle" or "goal" covers and guides everything else.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose the intervention level — automate, improve, or reengineer — consciously at the outset.", từ "outset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose the intervention level — automate, improve, or reengineer — consciously at the outset.", what does "outset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outset /ˈaʊtset/ (danh từ): lúc bắt đầu. "At the outset" = ngay lúc bắt đầu; "from the outset" = ngay từ đầu.
items.explanationEn: outset /ˈaʊtset/ (noun): the start. "At the outset" means at the very start; also "from the outset".

items.question: Trong câu "Resistance during elicitation is often not about the software but about control being taken away.", từ "resistance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resistance during elicitation is often not about the software but about control being taken away.", what does "resistance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resistance /rɪˈzɪstəns/ (danh từ): sự phản kháng, chống đối. "Resistance to change" = sự chống lại thay đổi; trong vật lý là điện trở.
items.explanationEn: resistance /rɪˈzɪstəns/ (noun): opposition to change. "Resistance to change" is opposition to it; in physics resistance opposes electric current.

items.question: Trong câu "Actual rules often differ from official rules — which to automate is an executive decision.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Actual rules often differ from official rules — which to automate is an executive decision.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (động từ): khác với. "Differ from" = khác với; danh từ "difference".
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from" means to be unlike; the noun is "difference".

items.question: Trong câu "These three specialised project types demand the same foundational requirements principles with different emphases and techniques.", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three specialised project types demand the same foundational requirements principles with different emphases and techniques.", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪʃənl/ (tính từ): nền tảng, cơ bản. "Foundational principles" = nguyên tắc nền tảng; danh từ "foundation".
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪʃənl/ (adjective): basic and underlying. "Foundational principles" are the basic ones everything rests on; the noun is "foundation".

items.question: Trong câu "Across all three: match the representation technique to the problem, focus on exception behaviour, and invest in requirements proportionally to the consequences of being wrong.", từ "proportionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Across all three: match the representation technique to the problem, focus on exception behaviour, and invest in requirements proportionally to the consequences of being wrong.", what does "proportionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: proportionally /prəˈpɔːʃənəli/ (trạng từ): tương xứng, theo tỷ lệ. "Proportionally to X" = tương xứng với mức độ của X.
items.explanationEn: proportionally /prəˈpɔːʃənəli/ (adverb): in a matching ratio. "Proportionally to X" means in a ratio that matches the size of X.
